title: Launch preflight evidence refresh
summary: Launch preflight now refreshes missing or stale encoder capability diagnostic evidence when backend prerequisites are available, runtime prep boundary rows report ready, and autonomy failure health keys off active failure markers instead of historical round reports.
reason: Launch readiness was showing review/yellow for backend-owned diagnostic evidence that could be regenerated, for deferred runtime prep that is expected to happen at start, and for old failure report JSON even when the Failure Resolution Center had no active marker rows.
behavior_before: Missing/stale encoder capability evidence remained a review row until manually refreshed; runtime prep boundary rows were review despite being intentionally deferred; autonomy health counted JSON under Failures/Reports as active failure artifacts.
behavior_after: Pipeline launch preflight attempts a bounded backend diagnostic refresh for missing/stale encoder capability evidence, marks runtime prep boundary rows ready, and only active failure marker JSON contributes to autonomy failure warnings.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed only on unrelated uncovered files: docs/generated/summaries/tests/python/desktop/test_preset_library.py.md, docs/implementation/local-api-test-split/PHASE_1_TEST_HARNESS_AND_SHARED_FIXTURES.md, docs/implementation/local-api-test-split/PRE_WORK_AND_BASELINE.md
rollback_plan: Revert the preflight encoder diagnostic refresh helper and runtime prep status change, restore autonomy failure scanning of failed report JSON, and revert the associated tests and route inventory wording.
